objective: Find whether installed New Outlook can send an already-saved draft through an external entry point while the Mac screen is locked, using static analysis only.

verdict.summary: /emails/send is a recognized but unimplemented case that returns false. immutableID and account resolution belong to /emails/open/message. AppleScript mailsend has a separate static send candidate. Locked-screen delivery is not established.

scope.offset_convention: VM addresses are unslid arm64 addresses. universal_file_offset counts from the beginning of the fat binary. arm64_slice_offset excludes the fat slice start. Framework addresses use that framework image base.

1_emails_send.behavior: handleEmailsURL lowercases the first path component, converts send to enum value 2, and returns Bool false through its async continuation. It does not look up a message, create compose UI, queue a send, or show confirmation on this branch.
1_emails_send.query_cannot_enable_send: Adding immutableID, accountID, account, origin, recipients, subject, or body does not alter the case-2 return branch.
1_emails_send.gate_scope: This describes the inspected handler branch, not LaunchServices, app startup, OS delivery, licensing, or other callers. No claim that URL delivery works while locked.

2_immutableID.format: Opaque Hx server-ID bytes encoded as standard base64, optionally using Exchange web-safe substitutions plus -> underscore and slash -> hyphen. Percent-encode any reserved URL query characters. This is not the standard base64url alphabet.
2_immutableID.transform: URL string -> replace _ with + and - with / -> NSData.init(base64Encoded:options:0) -> ActorAPI.fetchMessageByServerId(accountHxObjectID,messageServerId:NSData).
2_immutableID.hx_result_type: HxFetchMessageByServerIdResults.messageHeaderId is HxObjectID*; it is the result of resolution, not the URL identifier.
2_immutableID.rest_immutable_id_equivalence: Unverified. The query name does not establish Exchange REST ImmutableId format. The direct deep-link path performs no REST-ID translation. The separate loadRecordWithItemId:orImmutableId: method can translate IDs, but openMessage calls retrieveMessageWithServerID directly.
2_immutableID.padding: No padding restoration observed in the web-safe reversal. Decoder options are zero. Retain the encoding returned by the wrapper rather than assume arbitrary unpadded input.

3_accountID.format: Decimal integer string parsed as Swift Int, boxed as NSNumber, read as unsignedIntegerValue, and matched against OlxAccount.hash. Valid match is normally the nonnegative 32-bit HxObjectID hash. Not an email or GUID.
3_accountID.lookup: OlxAccountCollection.sharedCollectionWithoutLDAPWithoutOMC.accounts; first account whose hash matches. LDAP and OMC accounts are excluded.
3_accountID.where_it_lives: The URL value is derived, not an HxAccount.accountID string property. The underlying account HxObjectID lives in HxMessageHeader.accountId, typed HxObjectID*. The account wrapper exposes it through recordUID/ohxRecordUID.hxID.
3_accountID.hash_algorithm: For the exact installed HxCore arm64 representation: h=0; for each of 48 bytes of hxObjectId, h=(h*101+byte) modulo 2^32. a=(h*1103515245+12345) modulo 2^32; z=(h*69069+1) modulo 2^32; result=(z & 0xffff0000) | ((a >> 16) & 0xffff). This is build-specific native representation, not a general serialized-store recipe.
3_accountID.collision_behavior: The loop takes the first matching account hash. No collision disambiguation is visible.
3_accountID.separate_handoff_id: Handoff uses accountIdAfterSHA256 matched against accountIdSHA256Hash. It is a different identifier.

classification_procedure: Does an installed plist or action catalog declare the identifier? Record a declared entry point.
Does decoded control flow connect it to a send call? Record a static send candidate.
Has a permitted locked-screen delivery run proved success? No runtime runs were permitted, so none qualifies as proven.

user_activities.compose_and_view: ErageAppDelegate first handles universal links, then gated Handoff read or compose restoration. It retrieves a message and opens/restores UI. Telemetry objects also call send; these are not mail sends.
user_activities.send_intent: INSendMessageIntent is also listed as a user activity. No handling implementation or INSendMessageIntent class-name reference was found in the 211 scanned executable Mach-O files. Declaration alone is not a usable send path.

siri_intents.implementation_status: Unproven. No exact INSendMessageIntent, INSendMessageIntentHandling, or handleSendMessage:completion: reference found in the scanned executable binaries. application:handlerForIntent: occurs as protocol/selector metadata; no concrete implementation was recovered in the main binary method lists.

nsservices.scope: No NSServices entry in any of 215 discovered Info.plist files.

xpc_services.scope: No *.xpc bundle, XPCService entry, or MachServices entry in the inspected app bundle. NSXPCListener references exist in Office frameworks, so this is not a claim that all dynamic IPC is absent.
xpc_services.related_client_identifier_source: mso30.framework strings, universal offsets 0xb32716 and 0xb32757 in its x86_64 string output. These are Entra broker client references, not Outlook send-service declarations.
xpc_services.send_service_status: No declared external XPC send service found. Dynamically created anonymous endpoints were not exhaustively reverse engineered.

share_extension.scope: Only the CalendarWidget appex is installed under this bundle. No share-service extension declaration was found.

handler_chain: preview branch selects olxMessage, may switch draft store to targetAccount
OhxComposeActions.sendMessage:completion: at 0x10169e2cc checks draft and handles deferred send / DLP
apple_events.alternate_handler: ASStagedOutgoingMessage.handleSendCommand: at 0x1008e3640 materializes a staged message and delegates to sendMessage:.
apple_events.limits: This is a concrete static candidate, not proof of AppleScript message enumeration/addressability in the active New Outlook mode, runtime handler registration, Automation authorization, DLP completion, absence of UI in all downstream paths, or locked-screen execution. No Apple event was sent.

evidence.meaning: StaticString switch entries, stride 24. open=0, new=1, send=2, message=3, conversation=4, unknown=5. Pointers use chained fixups.
Async function pointer displacement 0xfeffad5c resolves to 0x102d17efc.
Read pathAtIndex(0), lowercase, parse with switch helper at 0x101fdf21c, compare case 2 and branch to 0x102d18138.
mov w0,#0; load continuation; restore frame; br x1. Complete false-return block with no send or query calls.
Paths.rawValue getter independently maps enum 2 to little-endian ASCII send.
open path reads second component; message=3 branches to 0x102d171e4; conversation=4 returns true without opening here.
openMessage first resolves account, then requires a nonempty immutableID, then reverses Exchange web-safe replacements.
Exchange web-safe reversal maps underscore to plus and hyphen to slash. This differs from RFC4648 base64url.
Calls retrieveMessageWithServerID:forAccount:completionBlock: via objc stub 0x103607ea0.
OhxAccountActions base64-decodes the supplied NSString with NSData initWithBase64EncodedString:options: and options zero.
Gets account.recordUID and unwraps it with OhxUnwrapHxObjectID.
Passes account HxObjectID as target and decoded NSData as messageServerId to ActorAPI fetchMessageByServerId:messageServerId:resultCompletionBlock:.
OhxMessage.serverId reads hxMessageHeader.serverId and encodes NSData as standard base64 with options zero.
OhxMessage.serverID exposes raw hxMessageHeader.serverId NSData.
queryAccountID reads account, not accountID. Parses signed decimal integer with overflow checks.
If account is absent or cannot parse, queryAccountID tries from as a decimal integer alias.
Constructs NSNumber with initWithInteger: from parsed Swift Int.
Resolve account through queryAccountID and OlxAccountCollection.sharedCollectionWithoutLDAPWithoutOMC.accounts.
Read NSNumber.unsignedIntegerValue for account match.
Calls each account.hash, skips values with signed high bit set, and compares hash against parsed account value.
OlxRecord.hash delegates to recordUID.hash.
OhxAccount.recordUID delegates to ohxRecordUID.
OhxRecordUID.hash delegates to hxID.hash.
Successful openMessage calls openMessages: on messageUIActionHandler. It opens UI, not a send operation.
Handoff compose activity constant com.microsoft.Office.Outlook.compose.mail.
Handoff view activity constant com.microsoft.Office.Outlook.view.mail.
Handoff account key is accountIdAfterSHA256, distinct from the numeric URL account parameter.
ErageAppDelegate application:continueUserActivity:restorationHandler: first routes universal-link activity.
ASMessage.handleSendCommand checks preview then obtains olxMessage for its new-store branch.
ASMessage.handleSendCommand invokes OlxComposeActions.sendMessage: in preview branch, or legacy message.send in other branch.
OlxComposeActions.sendMessage selects registered action implementation by message.storeType then calls sendMessage:.
OhxComposeActions.sendMessage: tail-calls sendMessage:completion: with nil completion.
Hx compose send implementation calls send:sharedAttachmentsPermissions:completionType:completionBlock: on ActorAPI after its draft and DLP handling.
ASStagedOutgoingMessage.handleSendCommand materializes a staged draft then calls sendMessage:.
Hashes 48 bytes of hxObjectId using a 32-bit multiply-by-101 accumulator and final arithmetic mixing. Not uint64Part or a mailbox GUID.

inventory.scope_note: Executable Mach-O files with executable permission, excluding symlink aliases. Plist and extension enumeration covers the entire bundle. Exact-name binary searches are supporting absence evidence, not proof against arbitrary dynamic name construction.

reproduction.verification: For every evidence record, read bytes_hex.length/2 bytes at universal_file_offset in the named binary and compare exactly. Verify whole-file SHA256 first. Decode chained fixup offsets relative to the image base when resolving selector and StaticString pointers.

unverified: Any send while the Mac screen is locked.
Any runtime URL delivery or app startup behavior.
Any live HxStore record or draft/account identifier.
Runtime AppleScript access and authorization in New Outlook.
Complete behavior of anonymous or dynamically registered XPC endpoints.

decisions.question: What is the scope and sizing?
decisions.decision: Medium static investigation, one owner, one JSON audit and PR summary. No product code, runtime probe, ADR, or new repository glossary. These are reversible research choices.
decisions.tradeoff: Keeps evidence together without adding a production interface or duplicate prose file.

decisions.question: Which architecture and offsets are authoritative?
decisions.decision: Analyze installed arm64 instructions and metadata. Bind every binary evidence range to whole universal-file SHA256, arm64 VM address, slice offset, and universal-file offset.
decisions.tradeoff: x86_64 control flow is unverified. Do not transfer addresses to another build.

decisions.question: What proves send behavior?
decisions.decision: Require decoded enum mapping plus the executed handler branch. Reject the send-by-ID hypothesis because case 2 directly returns false.
decisions.tradeoff: A send string or an intent declaration cannot establish sending.

decisions.question: How far may ID analysis go?
decisions.decision: Resolve types and transformations from installed code and public bundle headers only. Name HxMessageHeader.serverId and HxObjectID hash without reading any store.
decisions.tradeoff: No draft-specific value, mailbox sample, or REST ImmutableId equivalence can be validated.

decisions.question: How should alternative send entry points be graded?
decisions.decision: Separate declared entry points, traced send candidates, and runtime proof. Include the AppleScript mailsend candidate despite the URL hypothesis failing.
decisions.tradeoff: New Outlook scripting addressability, TCC, DLP, and locked-screen success remain unverified.

decisions.question: What is the delivery boundary?
decisions.decision: Commit and push only this audit, open a ready PR against main, and stop before merge.
decisions.tradeoff: Hosted CI may still be pending when the static investigation is delivered.

design_and_debt_pass.codebase_design: No executable interface changed. A single JSON audit keeps observations, evidence, decisions, and uncertainties together.
design_and_debt_pass.zero_tech_debt: No runtime adapter, compatibility flag, speculative sender, or duplicated markdown report was added.

verification.checks: Compare all source SHA256 values and all evidence bytes against installed files; compare app build, declared activities, intents, action catalogs, service declarations, extension enumeration, and scripting command metadata.
